channel.description: Fictional press releases for BEAM Decision-Maker Intelligence mock mode.

item.title: Ashvale Dental Partners Names Hollis Jessop Chief Executive Officer
item.description: Ashvale Dental Partners, a portfolio company of Aldermoor Capital Partners, today announced that Hollis Jessop has joined the company as Chief Executive Officer. Hollis Jessop was previously Chief Financial Officer of Silvaran Retail Group.

item.title: Hollis Jessop to Lead Ashvale Dental Partners as CEO
item.description: Aldermoor Capital Partners portfolio company Ashvale Dental Partners has appointed Hollis Jessop as its new chief executive, effective immediately.

item.title: Ashvale Dental Partners Appoints New Chief Executive
item.description: Ashvale Dental Partners said Hollis Jessop has been appointed Chief Executive Officer. The appointment follows a search led by the board.

item.title: Glenmara Packaging GmbH Promotes Niall Esposito
item.description: Glenmara Packaging GmbH announced that Niall Esposito has been promoted to Chief Operating Officer, with responsibility for plants in Bavaria and Saxony.

item.title: Zoltan Sandoval to Leave Wexcombe Group
item.description: Wexcombe Group announced that Chief Financial Officer Zoltan Sandoval will leave the company at the end of the quarter. A search for a successor is under way.

item.title: Blackwren Equity Agrees to Acquire Faircliff Education
item.description: Blackwren Equity has signed a definitive agreement to acquire a majority stake in Faircliff Education from Cindervale Partners. Terms were not disclosed.

item.title: Quenby Robotics Raises $85 Million Series C
item.description: Quenby Robotics today announced an $85 million Series C financing to expand its manufacturing capacity and grow its leadership team.

item.title: Penhallow Financial plc to Acquire Orlanda Hotels
item.description: Penhallow Financial plc announced it will acquire Orlanda Hotels in an all-cash transaction expected to close next quarter.

item.title: Heddrick Water Announces Restructuring
item.description: Heddrick Water will reduce its workforce by about 8 percent as part of a restructuring plan.

item.title: Dellavar Building Products Expands Into Europe
item.description: Dellavar Building Products opened its first European headquarters in Amsterdam and plans to hire a regional leadership team.

item.title: Rafferty Marchetti Named to Finance Leaders List
item.description: Rafferty Marchetti, Chief Financial Officer of Tessaline Energy Corp., was named to this year's list of 50 finance leaders to watch.

item.title: Teodor Northcott to Keynote Portfolio Leadership Summit
item.description: Teodor Northcott, Chief Executive Officer of Brisk Harbor Pet Care, will deliver the opening keynote at the Portfolio Leadership Summit in Chicago on {{date:+21}}.

item.title: Ostrana Software and Kelvaro Networks Announce Partnership
item.description: Ostrana Software and Kelvaro Networks announced a strategic partnership to integrate their platforms.

item.title: Tamsworth Aerospace Appoints Evander Holloway-Price Chief Financial Officer
item.description: Tamsworth Aerospace today announced the appointment of Evander Holloway-Price as Chief Financial Officer, effective {{date:+15}}.

item.title: Example Widgets Names New Marketing Chief
item.description: Example Widgets, a maker of home goods, named a new chief marketing officer.

item.title: Regional Bank Reports Record Deposits
item.description: A regional bank reported record deposits for the quarter.

item.title: Industry Survey Finds Rising Demand for Interim Executives
item.description: A survey of 400 companies found rising demand for interim executives in finance and operations.

item.title: Sample Foods Opens New Distribution Center
item.description: Sample Foods opened a distribution center in Ohio.

item.title: Conference Announces Speaker Lineup
item.description: The annual supply chain conference announced its speaker lineup for next spring.

item.title: Nonprofit Names Executive Director
item.description: A community nonprofit named a new executive director after a national search.
